ja389:1.1: Siṅgī migo āyatacakkhunetto (Cfr. II p..) aṭṭhittaco vārisayo alomo, tenābhibhūto kapaṇaṃ rudāmi, hare sakhā kissa nu maṃ jahāsīti.
ja389:2.1: So passasanto mahatā phaṇena bhujaṅgamo kakkaṭaṃ ajjhapatto sakhā sakhāraṃ paritāyamāno, bhujaṅgamaṃ kakkaṭako gahesīti.
ja389:3.1: Na vāyasaṃ no pana sapparājaṃ ghāsatthiko kakkaṭako adeyya, pucchāmi taṃ āyatanettacakkhu atha kissa hetu 'mha ubho gahītā ti.
ja389:4.1: Ayaṃ puriso mama atthakāmo, yo maṃ gahetvāna dakāya neti, tasmiṃ mate dukkham anappakam me, ahañ ca eso ca ubho na homa.
ja389:5.1: Mamañ ca disvāna pavaddhakāyaṃ sabbo jano hiṃsitum eva-m-icche, sāduñ ca thullañ ca muduñ ca maṃsaṃ kākāpi maṃ disva viheṭhayeyyun ti.
ja389:6.1: Sac' etassa hetu 'mha ubho gahītā uṭṭhātu poso visam ācamāmi, mamañ ca kākañ ca pamuñca khippaṃ, pure visaṃ gāḷham upeti maccan ti.
ja389:7.1: Sappaṃ pamokkhāmi na tāva kākaṃ, paṭibaddhako hohiti tāva kāko, purisañ ca disvāna sukhiṃ arogaṃ kākaṃ pamokkhāmi yath' eva sappan ti.
ja389:8.1: Kāko tadā Devadatto ahosi, Māro pana kaṇhasappo ahosi, Ānando bhaddo kakkaṭako ahosi, ahaṃ tadā brāhmaṇo homi tatthā
